questions.q: Why did Elimelech's family leave Bethlehem Judah for Moab?
options: There was a famine in the land
Elimelech was fleeing a blood feud
They were seeking wives for their sons

questions.q: Which daughter-in-law kissed Naomi and went back to her people?
What news made Naomi decide to return home from Moab?
options: The LORD had given his people bread
Her husband's land was being sold
A kinsman had sent for her
The judges had made peace in Judah

questions.q: What reason does Naomi give for asking to be called Mara?
options: The Almighty has dealt very bitterly with her
She no longer had a home in Bethlehem
Her name had been forgotten in the city

questions.q: Ruth said, "Your people will be my people, and ____."

items: Naomi and Ruth arrive in Bethlehem

questions.q: Naomi and Ruth arrived in Bethlehem at the beginning of barley harvest.
Naomi's family lived in Moab about twenty years before her sons died.
Where did Naomi first tell her daughters-in-law to return?
options: To the graves of their husbands

questions.q: How did the people of Bethlehem react when Naomi arrived?
options: The whole city was excited and asked if it was her
The elders came out to the gate to greet her
No one in the city recognized her
Her relatives prepared a feast for her

questions.q: Naomi said Ruth's sister-in-law had gone back to her people and to what?
Naomi said, "May the LORD deal kindly with you, as you have dealt ____."
questions.answer: with the dead and with me

questions.q: Naomi said, "It grieves me seriously for your sakes, for ____ has gone out against me."
At first both daughters-in-law said they would return with Naomi to her people.
Naomi's husband died after both of her sons had died.
Whose field did Ruth happen to glean in?
options: Boaz, of the family of Elimelech

questions.q: How did Boaz first find out who Ruth was?
options: He asked the servant over the reapers
Ruth introduced herself at the gate

questions.q: What did Boaz secretly tell his young men to do for Ruth?
options: Pull out grain from the bundles for her
Carry her grain into the city
Give her a share of the wheat harvest
Walk her home safely each evening

questions.q: What did Ruth call herself when she asked why Boaz noticed her?
Boaz said, "May the LORD repay your work... the God of Israel, under whose wings ____."
questions.answer: you have come to take refuge

questions.q: At meal time Boaz said, "Come here, and eat some bread, and ____."
questions.answer: dip your morsel in the vinegar
wrong: drink from the young men's vessels

questions.q: Naomi said the LORD "has not abandoned his kindness to ____."
questions.answer: the living and to the dead

items: Ruth asks Naomi to let her glean
Ruth brings about an ephah of barley home

questions.q: Boaz told Ruth to go glean in other fields as well as his.
Ruth kept gleaning in Boaz's fields until the end of both barley and wheat harvest.
Boaz told Ruth to stay close to whom while she gleaned?
How did Boaz greet his reapers when he came from Bethlehem?
What did Ruth do with the food left over after she was satisfied?
options: Brought it home and gave it to Naomi
Left it in the field for the poor
Saved it for the next day's meal

questions.q: Boaz said, "Haven't I commanded the young men ____?"
Boaz said Ruth had left "your father, your mother, and ____."
Naomi told Ruth that Boaz was one of their near kinsmen.
The servant said Ruth had worked since morning without resting at all.
Where did Naomi send Ruth to find Boaz at night?
What did Ruth ask Boaz to spread over her?
What problem did Boaz mention before he could marry Ruth?
options: There was a kinsman nearer than he
The elders had not yet agreed
Naomi's land had already been sold

questions.q: Why did Boaz give Ruth six measures of barley?
options: So she would not go empty to Naomi
As a bride price for her family
So she could sell it in the city

questions.q: Boaz said, "All the city of my people knows that ____."
Naomi said, "Don't make yourself known to the man until he has ____."
Boaz said, "You have shown more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, because you didn't ____."

items: Ruth washes and goes to the threshing floor
Boaz measures barley into her mantle

questions.q: Ruth told Naomi, "All that you say, I will do."
Ruth left the threshing floor at noon so that no one would see her.
What did Naomi say she wanted to seek for Ruth?
options: Rest, that it may be well with her
A field of her own to glean
A safe way back to Moab

questions.q: Where did Boaz lie down after he had eaten and drunk?
options: At the end of the heap of grain
In his house in the city
Beside his reapers in the field

questions.q: What oath did Boaz use when promising to do the kinsman's duty?
options: By the elders of the city
By the house of his father

questions.q: Naomi said, "The man will not rest until ____."
Naomi said, "Wash yourself, anoint yourself, ____, and go down to the threshing floor."
Boaz wanted the whole city to know that Ruth had come to the threshing floor.
When Boaz asked who she was, Ruth called herself his servant.
Where did Boaz go to settle the matter with the near kinsman?
What was the name of the son born to Boaz and Ruth?
Why did the near kinsman refuse to redeem the land?
options: He feared endangering his own inheritance
He had no money to buy it
He would not marry a Moabitess

questions.q: The people blessed Ruth to be like which two women who built the house of Israel?
The women said Ruth was better to Naomi ____.
To confirm the deal, a man ____ and gave it to his neighbor.
wrong: cut off a lock of hair

questions.q: Boaz married Ruth "to raise up ____ on his inheritance."

items: The near kinsman takes off his sandal
Naomi becomes nurse to the child

questions.q: The chapter says Obed became the father of Jesse, the father of David.
Naomi herself gave the baby his name.
What did the near kinsman first say when Boaz told him about Elimelech's land?
The women blessed the LORD for not leaving Naomi without what?
options: A husband in her old age

questions.q: The people wished for Boaz's house to be like the house of whom?
options: Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah
Isaac, whom Sarah bore to Abraham

questions.q: The women said the child "shall be to you a restorer of life and ____."
questions.answer: sustain you in your old age

questions.q: The people said, "Treat you worthily in Ephrathah, and ____."
Naomi was selling the parcel of land that had belonged to Elimelech.
Boaz made his agreement in private, with no witnesses present.
